messages:
Anna: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — I posted the RCA and an action table. Please confirm owners so we can close the loop. RCA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4321
incident-bot: RCA document created: INC-4321 — link above. Related postmortem doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/RCAs/pages/INC-4321
Lee: Thanks Anna. I'll own the infra verification and rollout checklist. ETA: 48h for verification, will update the table. @Jordan can you take the runtime perf checks? :eyes:
Jordan: Yup, taking runtime perf regression, shard logs, and KV cache trace. I'll add results to the action table and note any kernel-level anomalies.
Sam: Product Q: any user-visible behavior change we should call out in the release notes/comm? Also is there a risk of re-introducing the issue with the planned canary?
Anna: Sam — good call. The RCA notes the root cause (cache eviction + batching edge case). Short term fix is a config guard; long term is a kernel change. Canary will include the guard by default.
Maria: CS note — two customers on Dedicated hit errors during the window (accounts: Acme & BlueWave). Need a concise status blurb and owner for customer outreach. I can draft if someone owns the technical bits for the note.
Lee: I'll draft the technical blurb and hand it to Maria for tone. Target: internal draft in 3 hours, customer-ready in 8 hours.
Jordan: Action items I'm adding to the table: 
```
- Perf regression checkpoint: Jordan (runtime) — 24h
- Kernel trace + probes: Jordan — 36h
- Infra verification: Lee — 48h
- Canary deploy with guard: Ops — scheduled
- Customer comms draft: Lee -> Maria — 8h
- Post-canary QA: Anna -> Product -> 72h
```
ops-oncall: Hotfix deploy scheduled: 2026-04-01T18:00:00Z (canary), full rollout target 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z. Will post deploy runbook.
Anna: I've added the deploy times to the table and linked the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hotfix-4321. Please add brief status comments when you start/finish items.
Sam: Ok — product will pause promo traffic for affected endpoints during the canary window. Noting to avoid false negatives in metrics.
Maria: Draft of customer email posted to the doc — PTAL: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/INC-4321-comms
Lee: Quick ask to leadership: we'll need temporary priority access to two extra GPU nodes for repeatable perf tests. @Anna is this in-scope to greenlight?
Anna: Yes — approve up to 48h of extra capacity. Ops, allocate 2 n1-gpu nodes, tag as INC-4321.
ops-oncall: Allocated and tagged. Will monitor spend and report.
Jordan: I'll kick off the perf runs in ~30m and post the first summary here.
Anna: Thanks everyone. I'll compile a one-pager for the follow-up sync and add final owners. Expect a brief update in ~6 hours. :thumbsup:
Sam: Thanks team — let us know if product needs more context for external comms.
Maria: I'll coordinate customer outreach after Lee's tech blurb is final.
Lee: Noted. Marking owners in the action table now. :white_check_mark:
Anna: Closing note — please react with :eyes: once you've added your status to the table. File with actions/links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/RCAs/pages/INC-4321-actions
